title: A Program for Fluctuating Kinetic Theory
summary: A program for fluctuating kinetic theory is proposed in this paper to study nonlinear Lévy-type fluctuation corrections to kinetic PDEs in a unified way. The Vlasov--Fokker--Planck (VFP), Landau, and Boltzmann equations can each be decomposed into a kinetic transport term and a generalized gradient structure generated by a nonlinear dual pair of dissipation potentials.
